articles.title: GSK (LSE:GSK) Stock Looks Reasonable As Its 58% Run Continues
articles.summary: GSK has delivered a solid multi year share price run, helped by fresh moves in oncology and vaccines, and that raises a simple question for investors who care about valuation. Is the current price you see on screen today adequately supported by the earnings power of the business? Over the past 5 years GSK shares have returned 58.4%, which puts real weight on whether the current earnings justify where the stock now trades. articles.title: GSK (LSE:GSK) Agrees Multiple Myeloma T Cell Deal
articles.summary: GSK (LSE:GSK) agreed to acquire Chimagen's trispecific T cell-engager candidate for multiple myeloma, expanding its blood cancer research portfolio. The drug asset is described by the parties as a potential best in class trispecific T cell therapy targeting multiple myeloma. GSK plans to close its German vaccine manufacturing site and consolidate production in Canada, with associated job reductions and supply chain changes. articles.summary: GSK plc (NYSE:GSK) plans to close its vaccine manufacturing facility in Dresden, Germany, by summer 2027, putting 641 jobs at risk. The decision reflects declining demand for traditional egg-based flu vaccines, which has left GSK with more manufacturing capacity than it needs.
